parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource share.

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元名称。

长度范围：1~50个字符。

格式：允许输入英文字母、数字、中文、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: resource_share_name

fields.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can add up to 5 shared resources at a time.

`Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

`Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can add up to 5 shared resources at a time.

For more information about the supported resource types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html.

`Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html。

`Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of ARNs of the shared resources.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can add up to 5 shared resources at a time
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

parameters.help_en: The names of the shared permissions. If this parameter is left empty, the system automatically associates the default permissions that are related to the resource type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.help_zh: 共享权限名称。为空时，系统自动绑定资源类型关联的默认权限。具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.name: permission_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether sharing with accounts outside the resource directory or folder is allowed. Valid values:

false (default): Only sharing within the resource directory or folder is allowed.
true: You can share resources with any account
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许共享给资源目录外的账号。取值：

false（默认值）：仅允许资源目录内共享。
true：允许共享给任意账号
parameters.name: allow_external_targets

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The property parameter of the principal. For example, you can set the time period for resource sharing. Valid values of `timeRangeType`:
timeRange: a specified time period.
day: all day.
`TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
资源使用者属性参数。例如：您可以设置资源共享的时间段。`timeRangeType`取值：
timeRange：指定时间段。
day：全天。
`TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: property

fields.help_en:
The ID of the principal.

`TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
资源使用者ID。

`TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the principal.
You can set this parameter only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者属性。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时可以设置该参数
parameters.name: target_properties

fields.help_en:
The tag key.
The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。
最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.
The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。
最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。最多可以绑定 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource share was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 共享单元创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601（UTC 时间，精确到毫秒），例如 2020-12-03T08:02:22.413Z

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

ResourceShareOwner.description_en: The owner of the resource share

ResourceShareStatus.description_en:
The status of the resource share. Valid values:

Active: The resource share is enabled.
Pending: The resource share is pending confirmation.
Deleting: The resource share is being deleted.
Deleted: The resource share is deleted.

Records of resource shares in the Deleted state are automatically deleted by the system within 48 to 96 hours
ResourceShareStatus.description_zh:
共享单元状态。取值：

Active：已启用。
Pending：待确认。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除。

Deleted状态的共享单元记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource share was updated
UpdateTime.description_zh: 共享单元更新时间，格式为 ISO 8601（UTC 时间，精确到毫秒），例如 2020-12-03T08:02:22.413Z
